meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

copy.tagline: 创建、修改和优化技能，并评估其表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要创建或改进自定义技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, modify, and optimize skills, and measure their performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or improve custom skills

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步创建、修改或优化技能。它会帮你写技能描述、设计测试用例、运行对比测试，并根据结果反复改进技能。
howto.when: 当你提出要创建新技能、修改现有技能、测试技能效果或优化技能触发准确性时，Claude 会主动进入这个流程。

say.text: 帮我创建一个技能，用来把Markdown转成HTML。
say.note: Claude 会开始询问细节并起草技能。

say.text: 改进这个技能，让它触发更准确。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有技能并优化描述。

say.text: 测试一下这个技能的效果。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试用例并展示结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you step by step to create, modify, or optimize a skill. It helps write skill descriptions, design test cases, run comparison tests, and iteratively improve the skill based on results.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create a new skill, modify an existing one, test a skill's performance, or optimize its triggering accuracy, Claude will proactively enter this workflow.

say_en.text: Create a skill that converts Markdown to HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking details and draft the skill.

say_en.text: Improve this skill to trigger more accurately.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the existing skill and optimize its description.

say_en.text: Test the performance of this skill.
say_en.note: Claude will run test cases and show results.
